attribution.author: Tommy Richards
attribution.criterion_7_note: Revised per Criterion_7_Revision.txt to avoid circular reliance on Hebrews 4:12, evaluating living word evidence via John 6:63, 1 Thessalonians 2:13, John 8:31-32, 2 Timothy 3:16-17, and John 16:8.

criteria.name: Pattern Consistency
criteria.test_question: Does this passage follow internal patterns γραφή establishes elsewhere for similar situations?
criteria.pass_standard: Aligns with recurring textual and narrative patterns attested across γραφή without introducing anomalous rules or exceptions.
criteria.fail_standard: Breaks established internal patterns or invents one-off exceptions contradicted by broader γραφή witness.

criteria.name: Narrative Coherence
criteria.test_question: Does this passage create tension or contradiction with other passages about the same person, event, or theological principle?
criteria.pass_standard: Remains coherent with parallel accounts, personae, and core principles across verified passages.
criteria.fail_standard: Introduces direct contradiction or irreconcilable narrative friction with other passages.

criteria.name: Who Benefits?
criteria.test_question: If this passage were added, embellished, or altered, who gains politically, institutionally, theologically, or by silencing inquiry?
criteria.pass_standard: Serves truth and faithful alignment rather than coercive power, institutional dominance, or suppression of inquiry.
criteria.fail_standard: Primarily serves political/institutional control, coercive authority, financial/status gain, or shutting down scrutiny.

criteria.name: Structural Integrity
criteria.test_question: Does removal of this passage improve or damage the coherence and flow of the surrounding text?
criteria.pass_standard: Forms an organic, necessary link in the surrounding passage's argument or narrative progression.
criteria.fail_standard: Acts as a seam, interruption, or parenthetical break whose removal restores smoother flow.

criteria.name: Manuscript and Historical Evidence
criteria.test_question: What do textual transmission, early manuscript witnesses, and early reception tell us about this passage?
criteria.pass_standard: Supported by reliable early Greek witnesses and coherent early reception without major interpolation flags.
criteria.fail_standard: Marked by significant manuscript omissions, textual instability, late emergence, or known interpolation indicators.

criteria.name: The 2 Timothy 3:16–17 Test
criteria.greek_focus: διδασκαλία, ἔλεγμος, ἐπανόρθωσις, παιδεία ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ
criteria.test_question: Is this passage profitable for teaching (διδασκαλία), reproof (ἐλεγμός), correction (ἐπανόρθωσις), and training in righteousness (παιδεία ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ)?
criteria.pass_standard: Supports sound teaching, truthful reproof, restorative correction, and training in righteousness.
criteria.fail_standard: Undermines truth, promotes unrighteousness or harm, or fails constructive instruction.

criteria.name: Living Word Multi-Witness Test
criteria.test_question: Does this passage exhibit the qualities of living, active λόγος — spirit and life (John 6:63), effective working in believers (1 Thess 2:13), freedom through truth (John 8:31–32), and spiritual conviction (John 16:8)?
criteria.pass_standard: Harmonic with life-giving spirit and truth (John 6:63; John 8:31–32), active faith (1 Thess 2:13), and genuine conviction (John 16:8) without relying on Hebrews 4:12.
criteria.fail_standard: Produces death/bondage rather than spirit and life, contradicts truth/freedom, or relies on circular proof.

criteria.name: Ἰησοῦς Χριστός / Apostolic Citation Test
criteria.test_question: Did Ἰησοῦς Χριστός or the apostles quote, reference, or allude to this passage, or does it cite non-canonical/pseudepigraphal sources as authoritative?
criteria.pass_standard: Affirmed or harmonized by Ἰησοῦς Χριστός and apostolic witness without treating non-canonical/pseudepigraphal texts as authoritative scripture.
criteria.fail_standard: Contradicted by Ἰησοῦς Χριστός or apostles, or treats non-canonical/pseudepigraphal sources as authoritative.

criteria.name: Χριστός Character Match
criteria.test_question: Does this passage align with the character of Θεὸς Πατήρ as revealed in Ἰησοῦς Χριστός (John 14:9; Luke 9:55–56), or does it attribute διάβολος traits (John 8:44) to Θεός?
criteria.pass_standard: Reflects the Father's character revealed in Ἰησοῦς Χριστός (John 14:9; Luke 9:55–56) and does not ascribe διάβολος traits (John 8:44) to Θεός.
criteria.fail_standard: Depicts Θεός in a way that conflicts with Ἰησοῦς Χριστός or attributes deceit, murder, or διάβολος characteristics (John 8:44) to Θεός.

criteria.name: Πνεῦμα Fruit Test
criteria.greek_focus: καρπὸς τοῦ Πνεύματος / ἔργα τῆς σαρκός
criteria.test_question: Does this passage reflect or produce the fruit of πνεῦμα ἅγιον (Galatians 5:22–23), or does it reflect ἔργα τῆς σαρκός (works of the flesh, Galatians 5:19–21)?
criteria.pass_standard: Aligns with the fruit of πνεῦμα ἅγιον (Galatians 5:22–23) rather than ἔργα τῆς σαρκός (Galatians 5:19–21).
criteria.fail_standard: Promotes, excuses, or exemplifies ἔργα τῆς σαρκός (Galatians 5:19–21) over the fruit of πνεῦμα ἅγιον.
